theses.non_obvious_interpretation: In a tightening or uncertain interest rate environment, macro beta stagnates while market capital aggressively concentrates into idiosyncratic, catalyst-heavy altcoins with fresh capital allocation.
theses.mechanism_or_causal_chain: Fed rate hike compresses broad market beta -> traders rotate out of passive macro plays -> capital isolates high-conviction single-coin news (Paradigm ZEC allocation) -> sharp relative-strength expansion.
theses.contradiction_or_risk: A broader crypto market sell-off triggered by macro risk-off sentiment could eventually pull ZEC back into alignment with BTC.

theses.why_reader_cares: Prevents traders from shorting strong relative-strength setups based solely on macro rate expectations.

theses.observation: ZEC's price action displays a classic multi-stage 'Catalyst Transmission Staircase' on the 1-hour timeframe.
theses.evidence: 1H OHLCV shows an initial impulse from $1,249.99 to $1,385.65 on ~100k ZEC volume, followed by a 10-hour tight range between $1,345 and $1,380 on light volume (~11k–22k ZEC), and a secondary volume-backed surge (~38k ZEC) to $1,491.00.
theses.non_obvious_interpretation: The mid-rally pause was not momentum exhaustion, but supply absorption. In high-conviction news setups, mid-trend sideways consolidation represents institutional re-accumulation before liquidity sweeps upper levels.
theses.mechanism_or_causal_chain: First catalyst impulse clears immediate asks -> price pauses as limit bids absorb profit-taking -> floating supply dries up -> secondary buying wave easily sweeps thin resistance up to $1,491.
theses.contradiction_or_risk: If price breaks below the staircase landing at $1,342–$1,355, the structure degrades into a distribution pattern.
theses.confirmation_condition: A retest of the $1,423–$1,450 zone holding as structural support followed by a high-volume break above $1,491.
theses.why_reader_cares: Provides a reusable mental model to trade multi-stage news breakouts without panicking during healthy intermediate consolidations.
